name: Kumo Eyewear
description: A technical, restrained store theme for a small titanium eyewear atelier, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Mist grey, cool mid grey and ink charcoal with one titanium accent; Red Hat Display for display and text, Red Hat Mono for measurements. An engineering title-block header frames the wordmark, a drawing number and the menu in hairline cells; the home page leads with a filter-first frame directory: shape, material and fit pills over hairline product cells (without JavaScript every frame shows), each frame with a monospace measurement line (lens, bridge, temple, e.g. 47□21–145). Thin line drawings of the four frame shapes, a Fitting guide (the three numbers, four steps, fit sizes) and Lens options (lens types and prices, coatings); atelier, journal, newsletter and contact pages. A newsletter-led footer in cool titanium grey. The atelier address, hours and fitting appointments, and the frame directory, live in synced patterns so each is edited once; with WooCommerce the measurement line is each product's Measurements attribute (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the directory and orders go by email).
deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H6 + F4 + L14 are as planned (combination unused). The titanium accent #6F7F86 is 3.6:1 on mist, so it is kept to hairlines, the frame mark, line drawings and large marks; links and labels use deep titanium #56656C (5.3:1 on mist), quiet text #5B6166 (5.5:1), card white #F7F8F8 and light titanium #9AA8AE on charcoal were added. H6 differs from Ginrin Cycle (steel/orange, wheel mark) by a paper title block with a drawing-number cell, a lens-pair mark and a charcoal fitting cell; F4 differs from Hana Kago and Oto Radio by a cool titanium-grey letter band over a three-column colophon; L14 differs from Sumai Realty and Neiro Hall by shape / material / fit pill rows over hairline frame cells with measurement lines. Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/redhatdisplay, ofl/redhatmono), instanced (Display 300-600, Mono 400-500) and subset to Latin WOFF2; Red Hat Mono has no □ glyph, so the box in measurement lines falls back to the system font. Product photographs are 4:3 crops of the six supplied frame photographs (Haze Petite and Mist are mirrored tighter crops of Haze and Slate). Shop pills link to the WooCommerce shape/material category and fit tag archives (server-side, no JS); on the home and fallback shop page a small script filters the synced directory in place. Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry eyewear, colour tag grey and page tags fitting-guide and lens-options are new.
